boundary: Supplemental P1 task packs. Merge with V0.1; these are unstarted tasks, not evidence or release approval.

tasks.object: Imperial-axis first-entry and foreign-visitor reservation path
tasks.method: dated entry-path rehearsal + public transport arrival check
tasks.why: A first-time visitor route fails if the palace/civic anchor cannot be entered or the arrival friction consumes the day.
tasks.pass_criteria: A foreign visitor can reproduce the public entry path and the route has a realistic shorter version when queues, heat or fatigue rise.
tasks.blocking_condition: Unresolved identity/reservation rule, no reliable public entry path or no workable recovery exit.

tasks.object: Great Wall section, transfer and turnaround decision
tasks.method: complete public route at ordinary pace + weather/return-plan check
tasks.why: The Wall is a transfer-and-body decision; the route must not be sold from reputation alone.
tasks.pass_criteria: The selected public section has a stated body budget, a pre-set turnaround and a credible weather/return fallback.
tasks.blocking_condition: Unresolved transport, unsafe surface, no clear turnaround or an itinerary dependent on ideal weather.

tasks.object: Panda Base foreign-visitor entry and half-day operating shape
tasks.method: dated public entry rehearsal + transport and dwell-time observation
tasks.why: The panda anchor should consume the part of the day it genuinely needs, not silently destroy the rest of the route.
tasks.pass_criteria: A foreign visitor can enter through a reproducible path and the half-day has a realistic exit without adding a distant attraction by default.
tasks.blocking_condition: Unresolved reservation/identity rule, no reliable return path or route depends on an unsupported animal-activity promise.

tasks.object: Tea-park public life plus low-friction food context
tasks.why: Chengdu’s slow-city value depends on sitting, ordering and public rhythm rather than a list of restaurants.
tasks.pass_criteria: The route can explain public life and one food context without staging local encounters or making unsupported dietary claims.
tasks.blocking_condition: No clear dietary response, public access depends on private contact or the route becomes a venue-hopping script.

tasks.object: Liwan/arcade old-city route in heat and rain
tasks.method: complete public loop at normal pace + adverse-weather alternative
tasks.why: The old-city story must remain legible and respectful without turning humidity, retail noise or residents into hidden friction.
tasks.pass_criteria: One coherent public old-city loop and a shorter rain/heat version can be described without private access assumptions.
tasks.blocking_condition: No safe covered exit, route depends on private courtyards or the public explanation is overwhelmed by unresolved construction/access.

tasks.object: Cantonese food context and Guangzhou–Shenzhen handoff
tasks.method: venue communication/dietary check + transfer timing review
tasks.why: Food is a social system and the city pairing must not become a generic restaurant list or an unplanned transfer.
tasks.pass_criteria: The public food context and the city-pair decision are separately explainable with no unsupported restaurant or transport guarantee.
tasks.blocking_condition: Venue cannot answer key dietary/payment questions or the handoff depends on unverified live inventory.

tasks.method: public market walk + purchase/sourcing boundary test
tasks.why: A technology route must explain interfaces and supply chains without turning public observation into a sourcing promise.
tasks.pass_criteria: A visitor can observe one supply-chain question and leave without implying authenticity, wholesale access or guaranteed sourcing.
tasks.blocking_condition: Route requires private introductions, unsafe purchasing or unresolved filming/payment boundaries.

tasks.object: Public-facing technology route and corporate-access boundary
tasks.why: The route should show technology in daily life while stopping cleanly before private company access or corporate theatre.
minimum_evidence: permission response if filming is requested
tasks.pass_criteria: The public route is independently usable and every private-access claim is removed or separately released.
tasks.blocking_condition: The story depends on a company visit, identifiable-person filming or an unverified programme.

tasks.method: complete public route + museum/kiln access check
tasks.why: The product must explain material, labour, kiln and technical history rather than collapse into ceramic shopping.
tasks.pass_criteria: A visitor can understand one public porcelain-system question without relying on private studio access or sales claims.
tasks.blocking_condition: Public interpretation is unavailable or route meaning depends on an unreleased private encounter.

tasks.object: Workshop level, safety and public-release boundary
tasks.why: Courses, workshops, residencies and apprenticeships are different products and cannot be sold from social-media leads.
tasks.pass_criteria: Only the explicitly released public activity is described, with documented safety and cancellation terms.
tasks.blocking_condition: No accountable venue, unclear safety, no current terms or pressure to imply private artist access.
